description: Comprehensive cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) software for managing leads, deals, and sales automation.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 protocol with access tokens (1-hour lifespan) and long-lived refresh tokens.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a forever-free edition (up to 3 users) and use the Zoho API Console to generate OAuth credentials self-serve.
api_notes: Extensive REST and GraphQL APIs covering modules, leads, contacts, deals, workflows, functions, and analytics.
mcp_notes: No official Zoho CRM Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Zoho yet (though Zoho Analytics has an analytics-mcp-server repo).
rationale: Zoho CRM provides a broad public REST/GraphQL API and a forever-free tier with self-serve OAuth credentials via the developer console.

evidence.note: Details OAuth 2.0 implementation for Zoho CRM APIs
Confirms the forever-free edition supporting APIs and developer access
Lists REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and developer tools available on the platform
